title: Capcom Had to Officially Confirm How Tall Lady Dimitrescu Is
hook: Lady Dimitrescu went so viral in January 2021 that Capcom's art director had to post her official height: 9 feet 6 inches, hat and heels included. Village has since passed 10 million copies. Who is your favorite Resident Evil villain?
script: Did you know Capcom had to officially confirm how tall Lady Dimitrescu is? In January 2021, a short teaser for Resident Evil Village showed a towering vampire in a white dress and a wide hat. The internet lost its mind over her almost instantly. One week later she stole the Resident Evil Showcase, and the questions about her height kept coming. So Capcom's art director, Tomonori Takano, settled it on the official Resident Evil account. She stands nine feet six inches tall, or two point nine meters, hat and heels included. Takano admitted the attention was far more than the team had anticipated. He said nobody on the team could have predicted how fans would react to her. When Village launched in May 2021, Dimitrescu was only one part of the game, but she was its face. Maggie Robertson, the actress who played her, won Best Performance at The Game Awards that December. And Capcom says the game has now sold more than ten million copies. One tall lady in a teaser helped make Village one of Capcom's biggest hits. Who is your favorite Resident Evil villain?
